content.value: A toll booth at the entrance to a bridge can handle 120 veh/hour, the time to (08) process a vehicle being exponentially distributed. The flow is 90 veh/hour with a poissonian arrival pattern. Determine:
(i) the average number of vehicles in the system;
(iii) the average time spent by the vehicle in the system;
(iy) the average time spen by the vehicle in the queue.
